mutation_witnesses.invariant: A successful gateway response reflecting any declared hostile credential value fails before projection or durable ingress.
Local diagnostics redact the original member key and bearer form.
Local diagnostics redact the literal credential-file path independently of member-key forms.
Forwarded diagnostics structurally exclude arbitrary message, cause, and stack text.

description: A high-entropy gateway member-key sentinel is used for real HTTP Authorization while hostile upstream reflection is rejected and every emitted, queried, snapshotted, subscribed, diagnostic, audit, and durable representation remains secret-free.
invariant_check: The credential may exist only at its source and outbound Authorization header; no adapter/core output or durable byte representation may carry it or a common encoding.
